decisions: F9 fix (2026-06-24): In packages/core/package.json, added @aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner as optional peerDependencies + devDependencies, and added @types/pg to devDependencies. Chosen over optionalDependencies to stay consistent with the package's existing optional-peer pattern (pg/drizzle/walletconnect) so consumers aren't forced to install aws-sdk, while devDeps let core's own tsc resolve them. No production source code changed (package.json only).

F13 fix (2026-06-24): In packages/pack-loyalty/tsconfig.json, added 'src/ui' to exclude. The src/ui/*.tsx React components are not re-exported from src/index.ts and require react+lucide-react (not package deps); excluding them from the logic-only package's build matches the existing @tokenisation/pack-travel convention. Chosen over adding react/lucide/jsx config because the package is meant to be framework-agnostic and the UI is not part of its published surface. No product logic changed (tsconfig only).

F14 fix (2026-06-24): In packages/chains/package.json, added 'zod': '^3.22.4' to dependencies. Root cause of all 68 errors was zod missing from the manifest (imported in validation.ts/ChainlinkConfig.ts/DeploymentService.ts) -> TS2307 -> untyped z -> implicit-any schema callbacks (TS7006) -> validateOrThrow returns unknown (TS18046). Adding the dep restores full zod inference; no 'any', no source code changed. Version matches core/pack-loyalty. Same dependency-declaration class as F9.

F16 fix (2026-06-24): In packages/pack-travel/package.json, added 'typescript': '^5.3.0' to devDependencies. Sole root cause was 'tsc: not found' (typescript not in devDeps -> binary not linked). Verified earlier 'missing workspace deps' hypothesis was wrong: chains/pack-loyalty/sdk-react references are comments/TODOs; only @tokenisation/core is imported in compiled code and is already declared. No workspace deps added, no @types/node needed, no source changes. pack-travel typecheck+build exit 0; recursive build now passes pack-travel.

F20 fix (2026-06-24): In server/src/services/token.service.ts createToken(), added 'assetId: input.assetId' to the db.insert(tokens).values({...}) — the insert omitted assetId although the tokens table already has an asset_id FK column (-> assets.id, onDelete set null). One-line fix; schema/validation/architecture unchanged. Added server regression test server/src/__tests__/token-assetid.test.ts (seeds org+asset for FK; asserts persisted+round-tripped assetId, and null when omitted; 2/2 pass). Server typecheck PASS. Verified end-to-end via SDK consumer: token.assetId === asset.id. This was the sole remaining blocker for sdk_consumer_test.

F21 fix (2026-06-24): In packages/core/src/modules/assets.ts, added unwrapAsset() helper (returns body.asset ?? body) and applied it in create() and get() — both server endpoints return {asset:{...}} while the SDK types them Promise<Asset>; update() already returns a bare asset so untouched. Defensive (handles wrapped + bare), no error hiding (HTTP layer throws first). Server response behavior NOT changed (per scope). Added regression test sdk/tests/AssetsResponseContract.test.ts (3/3 pass). Verified in clean external app: README-style `const asset = await client.assets.create(...); asset.id` returns a real id, get(asset.id) round-trips, token created with asset.id. core+sdk typecheck+build pass. Simplified examples/minimal-sdk-consumer to README form. F21b (assets.list envelope) deferred as separate P2. Did NOT fix F20.
